mathematical_review.added_counterexample: gcd:ex:forms: F=sum x_i^3 and G=(1+h)x_1^3+sum_{i>1}x_i^3 are smooth over C[h]_(h), agree on the special fiber and are projectively isomorphic over C[[h]], but not over C(h). This is not an example of a nonzero equivalence-kernel descent obstruction.
mathematical_review.conclusion: No additional input hypothesis or withdrawal of the generic existence conclusion was required by the issues found in this review.
mathematical_review.theorem_scope: A cubic equation is defined over K=C(h); the full coherent residual equivalence preserving rotation and the specified cubic periodicity is obtained over some finite K-prime/K. Geometric projective uniqueness is among rotation-compatible models.

mathematical_review.prior_work: Carqueville--Kay Proposition 3.4 directly compares second-kind deformation cochains and polyvectors; it does not itself state the required full graded MF equivalence preserving rotation. Lowen--Van den Bergh and Blanc--Katzarkov--Pandit provide formal deformation/generator principles. Toën/Toën--Vaquié provide finite descent, perfectness and open equivalence criteria. BFK generation, Lin--Zhang rotation Torelli, and Ueda--Yoshinaga/Wang/Hwang gradient theory are known inputs. The manuscript specifies its relative, bigraded, normalized, coefficient-complete and finite-rank constructions separately.
mathematical_review.novelty_status: The completed MF construction, fixed three-object localization and their combination with algebraic generic reconstruction are presented precisely. No identical theorem was located in the checked primary sources; first occurrence and publication-level novelty of the combination remain unconfirmed.

added_results.symmetrizer_algebra: ej:lem:symmetrizer-algebra: finite étale E_F, field extension compatibility and unique finest geometric Sebastiani--Thom decomposition. These are organized as basic consequences of Hwang, not a new Jacobian Torelli theorem.
added_results.integration: gcd:prop:integrability-symmetrizer: E_F is linearly isomorphic to I_Q and L_Q; its dimension is the number of finest geometric ST blocks. Exact gradient Q corresponds to units.
added_results.restricted_orbits: Only the E_F-unit coordinate transformations and equation scalars are classified by E_F^*/[k^*(E_F^*)^3]; no full PGL or equivalence-kernel classification is claimed.
added_results.indecomposable: gcd:cor:indecomposable-equation: geometric ST indecomposability implies scalar uniqueness over k for a fixed gradient space; not kernel descent.
